claims: The official astronomical spring (vernal equinox) in the Northern Hemisphere in 2026 begins on Friday, March 20, at 10:46 a.m. EDT.
10:46 a.m. EDT is 14:46 UTC for the 2026 vernal equinox.
The 2026 vernal equinox occurs at 9:46 a.m. CDT.
The 2026 vernal equinox occurs at 8:46 a.m. MT.
The 2026 vernal equinox occurs at 7:46 a.m. PT.
Meteorologists consider March 1, 2026, the start of spring.
The 2026 vernal equinox marks the start of autumn in the Southern Hemisphere.
The vernal equinox is when the sun shines directly on the equator.
The vernal equinox results in nearly equal parts daylight and darkness.
The equinox happens when the Earth's axis is tilted neither toward nor away from the sun.
Following the 2026 vernal equinox, days will continue to get longer in the Northern Hemisphere until the summer solstice in June.
